title: C++ Program Structure and Syntax
learning_outcomes: Read and write the language’s surface syntax: tokens, statements, I/O, names, literals, formatting, files and diagnostics.
Apply the module concepts in a small, reproducible C++20 example and explain its expected result.
Identify at least one relevant boundary, lifetime, portability, tooling or correctness concern.
